'''Major Attaway''' is an American actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Attaway became a voice actor as an adult. Attaway first worked on [[Pokémon animation]] voicing several Pokémon during ''[[M23|Secrets of the Jungle]]'' before joining {{aniseries|HZ}}, voicing [[Murdock]] of the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]].
